data.narrative:
Avalanche Energy is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Robin Langtry and Brian Riordan that has raised $80M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes 9 peers, comprising 1 public company (LNZA) and 8 private firms including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation profiles to support a reliable peer-median approach—fewer than three datapoints met the narrow filtering criteria.

Stage-progression analysis was the applicable triangulation method. Using total capital raised ($80M) as a valuation proxy for Series A, a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the next funding stage yields $160M. This reflects typical Series A-to-Series B value accretion patterns in frontier technology.

The triangulated valuation range is $136M to $184M, with a median of $160M. This single-method range reflects conservative (15% discount) and optimistic (15% premium) variants around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer validation and the dependence on assumed step-up multiples that may not reflect Avalanche Energy's specific technology maturity, market timing, or capital efficiency relative to sector peers. Validation through expanded comparable analysis or revenue-based metrics would strengthen conviction in this range.
